constanta_north_centre_about.title: About the Centre
constanta_north_centre_about.note: This is the same Seamen's Club (Stella Maris / ITF) as listed for the South Port — but from here at Poarta 1 it's a short walk rather than a shuttle ride. Closed Orthodox Easter, 1 January, 25 December.

groups.label: Legal
items: ITF office on site — legal help for union members

constanta_north_centre_location.title: Location & Route

callout.text: Walkable from here — unlike the South Port, you don't need transport.

contacts.title: Incinta Port Constanța, Gara Fluvială, Clădirea Seamen's Club, Constanța 900900
contacts.sub: A short walk from Poarta 1 — the coordinator hasn't confirmed the exact distance yet

constanta_north_centre_location.note: From berths in the North Port (docks 1–10) it's a 10–20 minute walk on lit pavements to Poarta 1, and the club is right there.

constanta_north_transport_leaving.title: Leaving the Port

callout.text: Yes — shore leave is normally permitted. Always confirm with your Master or agent first.

rows.title: Poarta 1 — pedestrian, most convenient
rows.sub: Opens straight onto the Old Town · 24/7

rows.title: Shore Pass
rows.sub: Issued through your agent

sections.title: If you need a Schengen visa

rows.title: Shore leave limited to the port zone and Constanța city
rows.sub: With a valid Shore Pass. Leaving the city without a visa is forbidden

rows.title: Hi-vis vest required inside the port
rows.sub: Not required once you're past the checkpoint

rows.title: From docks 1–10 to Poarta 1: 10–20 min on foot
rows.sub: On pavements — no vehicle needed, staff-only areas aside

constanta_north_transport_leaving.note: Checkpoint contact: through your ship's agent, or the ITF inspector.

constanta_north_transport_taxi.title: Taxi

rows.title: Right at Poarta 1
rows.sub: Taxis reach the checkpoint in 3–5 minutes

constanta_north_transport_taxi.note: ~15–20 RON (~€3–4) — much closer than from the South Port. Unofficial drivers: white or yellow cars with no company markings, pushing their services near the gate. Always insist on the meter (Aparat de taxat) or book through Bolt.

constanta_north_transport_public.title: Public Transport

rows.title: "Poarta 1 Port"
rows.sub: ~50 m from the checkpoint

rows.title: Buses 42, 44, 51, 101
rows.sub: Straight to the railway station and through the city centre

constanta_north_transport_public.note: ~3 RON per ride, contactless bank card on the validator. Last bus around 22:30–23:00.

callout.text: Only the Romanian leu (RON) is legal tender. Euros are usually not accepted in shops or taxis, or only at a very poor rate.

rows.title: A stranger offers you a better rate
rows.sub: On the street, at the gate, or "just around the corner" — always a scam

rows.title: Being asked to go somewhere private
rows.sub: A car, a back room, an alley — a legitimate exchange never needs this

rows.title: No receipt offered
rows.sub: A real exchange always gives you a printed receipt with the rate used

rows.title: Know the rough official rate first
rows.sub: Check on your phone before you go — so you can spot a bad deal immediately

rows.title: Count what you receive, before you walk away
rows.sub: In front of the person who gave it to you, not after
